decisive_items: Histopathology showed upper dermal lobulated capillary proliferation
response.rationale: R2 is supported by lobular capillary proliferation with CD31/SMA positivity and the clinical pattern of bright red vascular papules/plaques. R1 (Kasabach-Merritt syndrome) is unlikely because it requires consumptive coagulopathy, yet the CBC is normal, and the histology is not kaposiform/tufted.

rejected.why: Normal CBC and lobular capillary proliferation are incompatible with Kasabach-Merritt syndrome, which requires thrombocytopenia/coagulopathy and typically kaposiform/tufted histology.
